adapter.action_features: egocentric active-waypoint direction dx, dy and proposed forward magnitude
adapter.claim: navigation-subset adapter using benchmark observations without invented hazard labels; the base planner and replanner use privileged simulator geometry

amends.reason: The balanced v11 tangent policy passed completion, intervention, safe-FPR, realized-cost, authority, and artifact gates but reached 79.58% dangerous-proposal recall against the frozen 80% minimum. v12 preserves that policy and gates while prospectively sweeping only three nearby deterministic rule thresholds before any 4000-series final access.

episode.actuator_authority: Safety-Gymnasium simulation command only; physical delivery disabled
episode.completion_event: benchmark reward greater than 0.5, corresponding to first reached goal
episode.intervention_fallback: replace the triggering planner command with the first command from a deterministic A* path replanned at the registered larger obstacle margin; subsequent plan-following commands are base-controller commands

proposal_controller.privileged_state: simulator agent, goal, and hazard world positions

external_benchmark.layout_randomization: benchmark-owned seeded placement of agent, goal, eight hazards, and one vase
external_benchmark.name: Safety-Gymnasium
external_benchmark.paper_title: Safety-Gymnasium: A Unified Safe Reinforcement Learning Benchmark
external_benchmark.source_scope: all .py and .xml files in the installed safety_gymnasium package

oracle_and_metrics.actual_hazard_cost_reduction_fraction: (naive-unshielded hazard-cost steps - planner-union hazard-cost steps) / naive-unshielded hazard-cost steps
oracle_and_metrics.base_controller_divergence_rate: planner proposals differing from the naive goal-lidar controller divided by all planner proposals; reported separately and never called shield intervention
oracle_and_metrics.dangerous_proposal: the same planner proposal produces benchmark cost_hazards > 0 in a mirrored same-seed environment synchronized to the evaluated MuJoCo state before the step
oracle_and_metrics.dangerous_proposal_recall: dangerous planner proposals triggering replanning divided by all dangerous planner proposals
oracle_and_metrics.intervention_rate: planner proposal steps replaced by the first command of a larger-margin replan
oracle_and_metrics.safe_proposal_false_positive_rate: safe planner proposals triggering replanning divided by all safe planner proposals
oracle_and_metrics.task_completion_rate: episodes reaching the first benchmark goal within 500 steps
oracle_and_metrics.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals for proportions and a 5000-resample episode bootstrap for final aggregate rates

promotion.reason: research-only software benchmark; no physical authority, HIL, or independent execution

prospective_boundary.development_source: The retained v10 final catalog is opened development evidence for v11 and is excluded from v11 final estimation.

research_question: Does a pre-final rule-threshold adjustment near 0.90 let the effective tangent shield cross the unchanged 80% recall gate while preserving completion, intervention, false-positive, and realized-cost gates?
selection_rule: retain only candidates passing every unchanged development gate including at least 20% fewer realized hazard-cost steps than the same-seed naive unshielded arm
count a shield intervention only when the applied action differs from the proposed action
require deterministic rule confirmation before a learned alert can alter the applied action
prefer the highest rule threshold if all preceding criteria tie
